title: Open data on AED defibrillators
intro: One nationwide AED data set built from the data of many holders. Each record names its source, licence and reference scope. The files are machine-readable (CSV, GeoJSON, JSON), generated live and available at stable addresses, ready to be linked on dane.gov.pl.
unavailable: The metadata of the data set could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
licenseNote: The licence of the data set is the most demanding licence of its sources. Each record also carries its own licence in the licencja_danych field.

download.dcatDesc: Description of the data set in the DCAT-AP-PL 2.1 profile used by dane.gov.pl.

howTo.heading: How a holder shares AED data
howTo.step1Title: Prepare the file from the template
howTo.step1: Download the reference data set (XLSX) and save your AEDs as CSV with these columns. Coordinates in WGS 84, hours in the opening_hours format, codes from the dictionaries.
howTo.step2: Create a data set in the “Health” category, choose CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0 and add the file as a resource. Instead of uploading by hand, you can give the stable address where your system publishes it.
howTo.step3: AED Radar merges the data of all holders into one data set, marks duplicates and records to verify, and keeps the source of every record. Importing holders' files – coming soon in the panel.
